title: Bearings at Camp Gallows named 'North-west past the black thorn: the Understory, Ness's hut' as a destination for 'The Hidden Root' (Keepers hidden in the wood) quest, but after extensively mapping Thornwold's deep wood (Split Beech, Heartwood Hollow, Root Tangle, the whole gallows-road branch) I never found a location matching that name or an entry point for 'the gap in the black thorn' — gave up on that thread.
